We need to determine appropriate criminal charge(s) for illegal fishing. The facts: using a three-unregistered vessel (三无船舶) in a prohibited fishing area, using illegal net (minimum mesh size 9mm, prohibited gear) to catch fish, amount 12,250 kg, profit 10,500 RMB. This is illegal fishing. The appropriate crime under Chinese criminal law: “非法捕捞、收购、运输、出售国家重点保护的野生动物罪” is not correct. The correct is “非法捕捞、收购、运输、出售国家重点保护的野生动物罪” is for wildlife. For fish, the crime is “非法捕捞、收购、运输、出售水产资源罪” maybe? Actually Chinese law: Article 322 of Criminal Law: “非法捕捞、收购、运输、出售国家重点保护的野生动物罪” for protected wildlife. For fish, there is “非法捕捞水产资源罪” (illegal fishing). The official label likely "非法捕捞水产资源罪". Also possibly "非法捕捞、收购、运输、出售水产资源罪". Need to check typical labeling in dataset. In earlier examples, they used "非法狩猎" for illegal hunting of protected wildlife. For illegal fishing, they might use "非法捕捞". The dataset likely expects "非法捕捞". Let's see similar cases: The first example had "危险驾驶;窝藏、包庇". Another had "非法狩猎". So they use concise labels. So answer: [罪名]非法捕捞<eoa>.

Check if also "使用禁用渔具" maybe "非法使用禁用渔具" but likely encompassed in illegal fishing. So single charge.
